C-ADAPTIVE-ACTION-CENTER.IntentSummary: Deliver one stable adaptive action-center vertical from global launcher through registry, deterministic ranking, existing feature adapters, preference allowlist, desktop/mobile motion, independent design audit and full regression.

T-001.Title: kafedra-flow-intake: define one action-center path, context precedence, degraded states and feature handoff

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The flow starts instantly from global, keyboard and selected-date launchers; never introduces a confirmation-only step; reuses existing domain forms; and remains complete on desktop, mobile and prefers-reduced-motion when context or preference reads fail.

T-002.Title: kafedra-design: specify stable desktop and mobile shell geometry, hierarchy, search, recommendation slots, groups, keyboard and focus

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The shell has exactly three fixed recommendation slots, fixed group order, calm density, no frequency-driven geometry changes, equivalent desktop/mobile semantics and a fully understandable prefers-reduced-motion state.

T-003.Title: kafedra-motion: define restrained continuity for desktop side sheet, mobile bottom sheet, interruption and reduced motion

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Motion uses measured short transitions without bounce or semantic dependence; selected action continuity is preserved; desktop/mobile remain responsive; and prefers-reduced-motion removes spatial movement.

T-004.Title: kafedra-data: extend the existing preference allowlist without migration or a second preference store

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: action.center.action accepts only known action IDs, remains account/workspace scoped and idempotent, rejects unknown IDs and keys, uses the existing backup-covered table and local fallback, and does not change SQLite schema.

T-005.Title: kafedra-feature: implement pure ranking, registry, adapters and the integrated adaptive action-center vertical

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Explicit context, domain facts, relative period, learned rank and static order are deterministic; all approved launchers open existing forms; selected dates survive; search works without LLM; preference and context failures do not block action launch; and desktop/mobile behavior remains equivalent.

T-006.Title: kafedra-design-audit: independently review implemented hierarchy, continuity, static state, accessibility, desktop/mobile and motion

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The audit returns PASS, REVISE or BLOCK with evidence for stable geometry, no duplicate forms, keyboard/focus, mobile parity, static clarity, prefers-reduced-motion and consistency with adjacent application screens.

T-007.Title: kafedra-tests: prove context precedence, allowlist safety, degraded mode and desktop/mobile regression

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unit tests prove lexicographic precedence and fixed slots; API-level tests prove allowlist safety and idempotency; Playwright proves global/keyboard/date paths, real form reuse, corrupted-preference fallback, desktop/mobile and prefers-reduced-motion.

T-008.Title: kafedra-release: verify unchanged schema, dependency graph, offline runtime and full release gates

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: No package or migration is added; existing installation, update, backup/restore and offline contracts remain unchanged; full project, release, GRACE and offline checks pass on exact PR head.
